note: Curated component elements are guidance, not per-class tag restrictions.

classes.name: syn-button
classes.description: Native button or link styling; use semantic HTML.

classes.name: syn-filter-actions
classes.description: Wrapping submit and reset action group for CRM filters.

classes.name: syn-filter-bar
classes.description: Optional wrapping CRM GET filter form; host applies query parameters.

classes.name: syn-filter-field
classes.description: Label and control group in an optional CRM filter bar.

classes.name: syn-frame--accent
classes.description: Optional 2px accent outline for a selected frame shape.

classes.name: syn-frame--facet
classes.description: Optional diagonal top-left and bottom-right facets.

classes.name: syn-frame--step
classes.description: Optional square-stepped top-right and bottom-left frame.

classes.name: syn-glow
classes.description: Opt-in themed shadow; decoration controlled by data-syn-intensity.

classes.name: syn-pipeline
classes.description: Keyboard-focusable scrollable CRM stage layout; host manages state.

classes.name: syn-pipeline-card
classes.description: Opt-in CRM record presentation, not a drag-drop widget.

classes.name: syn-pipeline-lane
classes.description: Named stage column with semantic list of records.

classes.name: syn-record-fields
classes.description: Responsive definition-list layout for key/value record details.

classes.name: syn-region
classes.description: Container query boundary for responsive compositions.

classes.name: syn-root
classes.description: Required style scope for Syntyr components and themes.

classes.name: syn-semantic
classes.description: Opt-in styling of native HTML elements.

tokens.name: --syn-accent
tokens.description: Theme accent color; also check --syn-on-accent contrast.

tokens.name: --syn-frame-border-paint
tokens.description: Solid or gradient border paint for optional frames.

tokens.name: --syn-frame-cut
tokens.description: Shared fallback corner size for optional geometry shapes.

tokens.name: --syn-frame-fill
tokens.description: Interior fill paint for optional shaped frames.

tokens.name: --syn-frame-inlay-paint
tokens.description: Optional translucent overlay on the inner shaped surface.

tokens.name: --syn-frame-outline
tokens.description: Solid border paint fallback for optional frames.

tokens.name: --syn-frame-stroke
tokens.description: Width of the optional shape-following border.

tokens.name: --syn-glow-alpha
tokens.description: Glow accent share; varies by scoped data-syn-intensity.

tokens.name: --syn-grid-alpha
tokens.description: Grid-line accent share; varies by scoped data-syn-intensity.

tokens.name: --syn-on-accent
tokens.description: Foreground color for the primary accent.

tokens.name: --syn-panel-padding
tokens.description: Per-panel padding; defaults to the existing fluid panel padding.

tokens.name: --syn-panel-radius
tokens.description: Per-panel border radius; defaults to square corners.

components.name: Button
components.notes: Use button for actions and a for navigation. ARIA states describe real application state.

components.name: Panel
components.notes: Choose native headings and accessible labels.

components.name: Form fields
components.notes: Real handlers and field validation belong to the application.

components.name: Form compositions
components.notes: Unreleased alpha.5 candidate only. Native form behavior, associated labels, server validation; use syn-region for container-responsive rows. The Radix adapter is separately optional.

components.name: Tables
components.notes: Use proper headers, captions and scroll containers.

components.name: Stats
components.notes: Named container must be an ancestor of responsive children.

components.name: Navigation
components.notes: Real links and aria-current only for the actual current page.

components.name: Application shell
components.notes: Load optional recipes CSS after core.

components.name: Marketing hero
components.notes: Load optional recipes CSS after core.

components.name: Charts
components.notes: Only styling hooks. Generate chart values and SVG geometry yourself.

components.name: Heatmap
components.notes: Supply textual cell labels, data-syn-level and real data.

components.name: Advanced geometry frames
components.notes: Load optional geometry CSS. One shape per frame; accent emphasis is additive. Refer to visual-intensity.md for pseudo-element ownership and backgrounds.

components.name: Decorative effects
components.notes: Optional CSS only. data-syn-intensity on .syn-root or nested regions selects quiet, standard or cinematic effects without changing semantic state.

components.name: CRM compositions
components.notes: Unreleased alpha.5, CSS-only optional layouts. Use a GET form, labelled stages, focusable board overflow and definition-list details; application implements filtering and pipeline state.

recipes.description: Server-driven filter toolbar with wrapping fields and submit/reset actions.
recipes.host_behavior: Supply method=get, named controls, actual action URL and meaningful reset link. The host filters results; CSS does not execute queries.

recipes.description: Horizontally scrollable semantic data table with optional numeric cells and native pagination links.
recipes.host_behavior: Provide caption, real th scope associations, keyboard-reachable horizontal overflow where needed, actual page links and server-side sort/filter. CSS does not sort, page or select records.

recipes.description: Responsive application shell with navigation rail and primary workspace.
recipes.host_behavior: Provide labelled navigation, unique main landmark, actual routes and authorization for each destination. Theme must be placed on .syn-root or a scoped ancestor.

recipes.description: Labeled field/error compositions for host-validated forms.
recipes.host_behavior: Host supplies server/client validation, error text, stable error IDs, aria-describedby, aria-invalid and focus to an error summary when submission fails. CSS never performs validation or focus changes.
